```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

triangulation <- read.csv(
  params$triangulation_csv,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

triangulation_summary <- read.csv(
  params$triangulation_summary_csv,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

distribution_summary <- read.csv(
  params$distribution_summary_csv,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

# Overview

This report compares household estimates from the ratio-change method with WorldPop growth-factor estimates for each Enumeration Area in Malawi.

```{r overview-placeholder}
summary_table <- data.frame(
  Measure = c(
    "Total number of EAs included",
    "Percentage of ratio-change estimates within WorldPop confidence interval",
    "Mean percentage difference",
    "Median percentage difference"
  ),
  `Ratio-change` = c(
    as.character(triangulation_summary$ratio_change_eas),
    rep("", 3)
  ),
  WorldPop = c(
    as.character(triangulation_summary$worldpop_eas),
    rep("", 3)
  ),
  Value = c(
    as.character(triangulation_summary$total_eas),
    sprintf("%.2f%%", triangulation_summary$pct_within_ci),
    sprintf("%.2f%%", triangulation_summary$mean_pct_diff),
    sprintf("%.2f%%", triangulation_summary$median_pct_diff)
  )
)

knitr::kable(summary_table, row.names = FALSE)
```

# Distribution of Differences

```{r distribution-placeholder}
knitr::kable(
  distribution_summary,
  col.names = c("Statistic", "Percentage difference"),

  digits = 2
)

knitr::include_graphics(params$distribution_plot_file)
```
